answer: An agent economy can resist sybils with a mirror escrow bond: every identity locks a refundable deposit in escrow, and a walnut-hard rule shell releases it only after independent peers verify real completed work. A falcon-fast audit flags fake output, and one confirmed cheat forfeits the bond plus a cut of the shared pool. Spinning up a thousand fake identities means funding a thousand deposits and losing them at the first audit, so the attack costs far more than the influence it buys.
